tast: Write results dir even when no tests are run. Update "tast run" to collect logs and crashes from the DUT and write a results directory when the test runner fails before returning any test results. Previously, a results dir was only written if at least one result was received. Also fix an incorrect Log/Logf call from an earlier change. BUG=chromium:928445 TEST=updated unit tests; also manually verified that system logs and crashes are now collected when the ready function times out before any tests are run Change-Id: I15ba1b55f167e4b5202c432e52d6a025fa14207f Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1481543 Commit-Ready: Dan Erat <derat@chromium.org> Tested-by: Dan Erat <derat@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Shuhei Takahashi <nya@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hidehiko Abe <hidehiko@chromium.org>

tast: Increase result size to 50MB. Currently, it is throttled up to 20MB, and as its result, log files are trimmed unexpectedly. This increases the size to 50MB for crosbolt, informational and mustpass Tast tests. Because Tast consolidates multiple tests as if it is one autotest task, the result size is the accumulation of them. Note that, example and skylab-stage runs just a few tests, so they are out of focus in this CL. BUG=chromium:934090 TEST=Ran try. Change-Id: I7d81cafceca9cb37d3bb7e2fe29edef83072813a Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1483550 Commit-Ready: Hidehiko Abe <hidehiko@chromium.org> Tested-by: Hidehiko Abe <hidehiko@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Dan Erat <derat@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Aviv Keshet <akeshet@chromium.org>
